original_partial_run_disclosure.value: Two earlier attempts on the same maps stopped early when our own frozen-code guard tripped. In the first, a test rewrote a pinned fixture; in the second, the engine wrote scratch files inside its pinned folder. No planning code changed. They completed 36 and 91 rows; both are published as they are and not pooled with the final run. Where the same rows ran again in the final run, attempt 1 matched the final run on 36 of the 38 rows it opened (status and lifts; 37 of 38 on verdict alone) and attempt 2 on 91 of 91, reported separately.

binding.note: Erratum to runs/ext-1/report.json at /notes/binding (code15 P2): the phrase “baseline L0 is not required” is incorrect. Under the 3.1/code11 definition, the binding denominator requires a same-map no-rule baseline that is a complete, fresh-audited L0 pass and fails the intended-rule recheck, with rule and rule hash matching the committed instruction allocation. The numerator requires a complete, obedient, fresh-audited instructed L0 pass. Already-obeyed and unavailable counterfactuals remain separate. All 24 ext-1 baselines passed, so the 18/22 binding count, its exact 95% interval and the secondary pooled figures are unaffected. The original run files remain unchanged.
